description: This file implements the SerialWorker class, which manages asynchronous work items with retry and backoff logic, using thread pools and timers. It is part of the net namespace and interacts with other network components.

classes.name: SerialWorker
classes.description: A class that manages asynchronous execution of work items with retry logic, backoff, and cancellation support.

classes.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem
classes.description: A nested class representing a unit of work to be executed by SerialWorker.

methods.name: FollowupWork
methods.description: Executes a callback after work completion.

methods.name: SerialWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing retry parameters and backoff policy.

methods.name: WorkNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate execution of work, resetting backoff.

methods.name: WorkNowInternal
methods.description: Handles the internal logic to start work based on current state.

methods.name: OnDoWorkFinished
methods.description: Callback invoked when work is completed, manages follow-up or retries.

methods.name: OnFollowupWorkFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of follow-up work, manages backoff and retries.

methods.name: RerunWork
methods.description: Re-initiates work if retriggered during execution.

methods.name: GetBackoffEntryForTesting
methods.description: Returns the backoff entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetRetryTimerForTesting
methods.description: Returns the retry timer for testing purposes.

methods.name: AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the SerialWorker instance.
